decisions.summary: The record first: the village-lanes entry rewritten from what was read (brief R1), the drawing page (brief R2) after D2-D4 land
decisions.why: FR-001 and US1 as written; the GM's question is answered from the research before the engine moves.

decisions.summary: Passage is offered only where access_corridor finds no corridor for the household
decisions.why: The spec's FR-002 puts no such condition on the passage, so the plan narrows when it may be used. It is implied by the GM's own words: 'if that is what the research bears out, then we should go with it'. Every passage-to-the-road entry in Wigmore Part V Section 8 is conditioned on the land having no access of its own (Idzumi and Echigo 'pouch-land'; Uzen, Kaga, Idzumo, Suwo, Chikugo 'cannot reach the highway without passing over'); no entry read attests a household with its own access crossing a neighbor's land. Purpose test: the GM's purpose is that no unresearched requirement be imposed; this order is the record's own condition, not an added rule, so it does not gut the purpose. A household beyond the condition keeps the lane the engine already gives it.

decisions.summary: PASSAGE_REACH_FT, about 40 ft (grow_gap plus a dooryard's depth), labeled GUESS: the leg runs to a neighbor's threshing yard within that reach
decisions.why: Operationalizes the spec's 'a neighbor's dooryard' (adjacency) as a calibrated degree, labeled GUESS with its derivation, as constitution XII asks; a design constant derived from engine constants, not a measured figure.

decisions.summary: The leg is clear of every house, bed, shed, byre, well pocket, fixture, other placed homestead, refused ground and reserved wood seats; it is not drawn as a lane
decisions.why: FR-002 'never across a house, a garden bed, a shed or a fixture' and US2 'has no lane of its own'; excluding a third household's ground keeps the crossing to the neighbor's yard the spec names. Not drawing it as a lane is labeled the record's reading, a GUESS.

decisions.summary: A chain of passages ends at a corridor within PASSAGE_CHAIN = 2 households, a GUESS citing Wigmore's Echigo entry
decisions.why: The spec's edge case and FR-002 delegate any chain limit to the plan as a labeled GUESS citing Echigo, 'as far as the record's reading allows'. Echigo's C passes over both B's plot and A's: two plots, the longest chain read. The plan sets the limit at exactly the record's reading and labels it.

decisions.summary: PASSAGE_SHARE_BAND = (0.0, 0.25) rolled per nucleated settlement from the seed, a GUESS; beyond the share a household needs a corridor
decisions.why: FR-002 asks for a share rolled per settlement within a band the record supports or labels as a guess; it is labeled, and its upper bound is reasoned from entries the record holds (Enoshima's alleys behind the street, Morse; the Manchu survey's blind alleys to the houses - both on 0081 line 42). A rolled degree is calibrated liberty, not a strict rule.

decisions.summary: reached_across on the household record; the one reach predicate (checks.unreached_houses) counts a chain ending at a reached household; nothing else of the ways changes
lanes_of lays the door leg as the web does so tree.admits judges the drawn lane; feature 314 R12's withdrawn lever retried by abab.sh and kept only if it pays
decisions.why: FR-004 and SC-003. The retry serves FR-006 and the GM's concern about 'disregard[ing] optimizations that we know work'; it is kept only if it pays and FR-005 still holds.

decisions.why: FR-007 and SC-006 as written, matching the GM's 'coordinate with that other session' and 'all known bugs to be fixed'.
